note: Downgraded to verified=false: no Junos configuration fixture exists in this repository (tests/fixtures/golden/junos holds only `show version` and `show lldp neighbors`), and the renderer was emitting commands its own allowlist refused — `interface-mode` where the allowlist authorises `port-mode`, plus `set vlans ... l3-interface` which was absent entirely. A rendering the gate refuses cannot have been lab-verified. The renderer now uses `port-mode` (EX/VC family) to match the authorised templates; QFX-family devices need `interface-mode` and must be re-verified before this renderer is trusted on them (L01, T2).

commands: set interfaces irb unit {vlan_id} family inet address {address}
set interfaces {interface} unit 0 family ethernet-switching port-mode trunk
set interfaces {interface} unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members [{allowed_vlans_csv}]
set interfaces {interface} unit 0 family ethernet-switching port-mode access
set interfaces {interface} unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members {vlan_id}
